user.title: Kramer switcher or scaler
user.description: Configure for use with your connected device

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Kramer unit
reconfigure.description: Configure for use with your connected device

other.title: Other model (Protocol 2000)
other.description: Configure your switcher. If you don't know how many presets it supports you can leave it at 0 and change it later using "Reconfigure".

data.supports_modes: Supports separate audio and video switching
data.preset_slots: Number of presets the unit can store (0 if none)

data_description.force_lock: Locks the device's front panel whenever the integration is connected, which stops a front-panel button being left flashing and blocking control. Buttons on the device will not work while it is locked. You can change this later with the "Panel lock (forced)" switch.

shared.title: Address already used
shared.description: {entry} already uses {host}:{port} and is disabled. Only one device can use this address at a time. Either assign a unique IP/port combination, or keep {entry} disabled while this one is enabled, and disable this one before enabling {entry} again.

menu_options.connection: Go back and change the address

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the IP address and port.
error.no_reply: Connected, but the device did not answer. Check the cable and that the protocol, model chosen, machine number and serial settings - including baud rate - match the device.
error.no_reply_vp729: Connected, but nothing answered like a VP-729. Check that this is the VP-729's Ethernet port (5000 unless changed), that no password is required on that port, and that the model chosen is right.
error.type_change: You can only use Reconfigure to change a device for another of the same device type. To switch device type (for example between a matrix switcher, a presentation switcher and a video processor), add a new device instead.
error.name_in_use: A Kramer device called "{name}" already exists. This integration requires that each device has a unique name, so please choose a different one.
error.address_in_use: "{entry}" is enabled and already uses {host}:{port}. Either use a different IP/port for this device, or disable "{entry}" first and then add this one.
error.no_reply_sp11d: Connected, but the device did not answer. Check the cable and that the model chosen and serial settings - including baud rate - match the device's configuration. Also check the DIP switches on the device are correctly set.
error.name_required: Please enter a name for this device.
error.no_reply_vp436: Connected, but the device did not answer. Check the cable and that the model chosen and serial settings - including baud rate - match the device's configuration.

abort.already_configured: This switcher is already set up.
abort.no_options: A VP-729 has no names or presets to configure here. Use its Custom refresh switch and Refresh interval number to change how often it is read, and Reconfigure to change its address.

names.title: Input and output names
names.description: One name per line, in order. Leave a line blank to use the default.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Every preset is listed. Filled or Empty is read from the unit just now. A description after the dash is a HASS description (not stored on device).

slot.title: Preset
slot.description:
Preset {preset} is **{state}** on the unit.

HASS description (not stored on device): {description}

menu_options.store: Store the present routing in this preset
menu_options.describe: Set or change the HASS description (not stored on device)
menu_options.forget: Forget in HASS – presets on the unit can be overwritten but cannot be deleted

store.title: Store a preset
store.description:
{warning}

This stores the present video routing, audio routing and mode (Audio follows video or Breakaway) together. A preset on the unit can be overwritten but never deleted.

recall.title: Recall a preset
recall.description:
Recalling preset {preset} will change the routing now. {contents}

A full recall also sets the mode (Audio follows video or Breakaway) that was stored with it.

describe.title: Describe a preset
describe.description: This description is for preset {preset}. It is kept in Home Assistant only. It is not stored on the unit.

forget.title: Forget a HASS description
forget.description:
Forget in HASS – presets on the unit can be overwritten but cannot be deleted.

This removes only the HASS description ("{description}") for preset {preset}. The preset on the unit is not changed and it will still be **{state}**.

names_av.title: Input and output names
names_av.description: One name per line, in order. Leave a line blank to use the default. Each input and output has a video name and an audio name.

error.too_many_names: More names than the switcher has ports.
error.command_failed: The unit refused or did not answer: {error}
error.description_required: Enter a description, or go back and choose Forget.
error.description_too_long: Keep the description to 60 characters or fewer.
error.description_numeric: A description cannot be only digits, because digits mean a preset number.
error.description_duplicate: Another preset already has that description.

abort.unit_unavailable: The unit is not answering, so its presets cannot be shown. Try again when it is connected.
abort.slot_blank: Preset {preset} is empty, so there is nothing to recall.
abort.preset_stored: Stored the present setup in preset {preset}.

set_route.name: Set route
set_route.description: Send one input to one or more outputs. Inputs and outputs can be given by number or by name. On units with separate audio, choose whether to move video, audio or both.

input.name: Input
input.description: Input number or name. Use Off (or 0) to disconnect, on models that can.

outputs.name: Outputs
outputs.description: Output numbers or names, or all.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: Video and audio (default), video only, or audio only. Audio alone needs Breakaway mode.

store_preset.name: Store preset
store_preset.description: Store the present setup in a preset. Refuses a filled preset unless overwriting is confirmed. A stored preset cannot be deleted, only overwritten.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset number, or its HASS description.

audio_only.name: Audio only
audio_only.description: Store only the audio routes (models with separate audio).

confirm_overwrite.name: Confirm overwrite
confirm_overwrite.description: Must be true to overwrite a filled preset.

recall_preset.name: Recall preset
recall_preset.description: Recall a stored preset. A full recall also sets the stored mode.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset number, or its HASS description.

audio_only.name: Audio only
audio_only.description: Recall only the audio routes (models with separate audio).

set_routing_mode.name: Set routing mode
set_routing_mode.description: Choose Audio follows video or Breakaway. In Audio follows video every audio output follows its video input, and separate audio routes are lost.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Audio follows video, or Breakaway (audio and video routed separately).
